entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press one.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something? I bought these cycling shoes, but I'm just so confused by the whole thing. The website was a lot.
I can certainly help you look into that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... VF77491.

Thank you, Maria. One moment. Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Grip cycling shoes, delivered on January 2nd. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference or fit issue?

Oh, um, a preference I guess? I don't think they're broken. They just feel very stiff and I couldn't figure out the cleats at all. I wore them in the house for ten minutes and I think they'd give me blisters. I'm just really overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Maria. It's completely understandable. Getting the right fit and feel is the most important part of any gear. I want to assure you that you are well within our 90-day return policy for shoes.
Wait, 90 days? Oh, that's a relief. So... I can get a refund then? I wasn't sure what to do.

Absolutely. Since you received the item just five days ago, you are eligible for a full refund. The process is very straightforward. I am generating a prepaid return label for you right now and sending it to the email address we have on file.
Okay... so I just print that and put it on the box?

That's exactly right. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse logs the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method automatically.
Oh, that's much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, David. I really appreciate you walking me through that.
It's my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
